mapper.sql: RESERVATION_SN, ORDER_NO, RESERVATION_STTS_CD, CHECK_IN_DATE, CHECK_OUT_DATE, NGT_CNT, GUEST_CNT, TOTAL_AMT, CRNC_CD, HOLD_EXPRY_DT
mapper.select: SELECT R.ROOM_SN, R.HOUSE_SN, H.PRTNR_SN, R.ROOM_NM, R.ROOM_STTS_CD, H.HOUSE_STTS_CD FROM ROOM R JOIN HOUSE H ON H.HOUSE_SN = R.HOUSE_SN AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE R.ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT VER_NO FROM TRMS_MST WHERE TRMS_SN = #{trmsSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVATION ( ORDER_NO, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, RESERVATION_STTS_CD, PRTNR_SN, HOUSE_SN, ROOM_SN, RESERVER_USER_SN, CHECK_IN_DATE, CHECK_OUT_DATE, NGT_CNT, GUEST_CNT, TOTAL_AMT, CRNC_CD, HOLD_EXPRY_DT, HOLD_ID, REG_DT, RGTR_SN, MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{reservationSttsCd}, #{prtnrSn}, #{houseSn}, #{roomSn}, #{reserverUserSn}, #{checkInDate}, #{checkOutDate}, #{ngtCnt}, #{guestCnt}, #{totalAmt}, #{crncCd}, #{holdExpryDt}, #{holdId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{rgtrSn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )

INSERT INTO RESERVATION_GUEST ( RESERVATION_SN, GUEST_TYPE_CD, GUEST_NM, GUEST_MBL_TELNO, PII_PURGE_DUE_DT, REG_DT, RGTR_SN, MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{reservationSn}, #{guestTypeCd}, #{guestNm}, #{guestMblTelno, typeHandler=egovframework.eeum.base.crypto.GuestMblTelnoEncryptedTypeHandler}, #{piiPurgeDueDt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{rgtrSn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM RESERVATION WHERE RESERVER_USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY RESERVATION_SN DESC

SELECT RESERVATION_SN, ORDER_NO, RESERVATION_STTS_CD, ROOM_SN, CHECK_IN_DATE, CHECK_OUT_DATE, NGT_CNT, GUEST_CNT, TOTAL_AMT, CRNC_CD, HOLD_EXPRY_DT, HOLD_ID FROM RESERVATION WHERE RESERVATION_SN = #{reservationSn} AND RESERVER_USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' FOR UPDATE
